```{=html}
<main class="art-page">
  <section class="art-hero">
    <div>
      <p class="art-kicker">Sketchbook</p>
      <h1>Portraits, studies, and small visual experiments.</h1>
      <p>A gallery of drawings and sketches that sit alongside my technical work: more tactile, more observational, and just as curious.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="art-stats" aria-label="Gallery statistics">
      <div><strong>59</strong><span>pieces</span></div>
      <div><strong>Graphite</strong><span>primary medium</span></div>
      <div><strong>Studies</strong><span>portraits & forms</span></div>
    </div>
  </section>
```
